# MA — Mastercard (IDEATION 2026-11-06)

**Signal / why now:** MA is the one GLOBAL MOMENTUM row that is genuinely un-carded and new to the stack — #7 at $655.92, −2.49% off the 52-week high, mom6 +31.4%, mom1 +15.2%, ADV $2.0bn. It is a high-quality toll booth; the problem is the entry price, not the business.

**The fast-disqualify is on the target.** A valuation-anchored target cannot be established from this session's inputs: there is no MA dossier, the inbox is empty, and the token discipline forbids opening a 10-K to price a mega-cap that is trading at its high. Without a target there is nothing to test the entry against, and the base-rate up-leg (`momentum_continuation` 0.50/+30/−22) is the *weakest* edge in the book by its own note. EV at the prior is a thin +4.0%, entirely procyclical.

**V precedent, same week:** V was DISCARDed on 2026-11-02 for exactly this — sitting on the 52-week high, mom6 +26.6%, "a paying-up entry, not a drawdown". MA is the better capitalised version of the same trade; carding it would queue a Saturday deep-dive that the desk already knows how to refuse.

Archetype: `momentum_continuation` · method card: MOMENTUM_CONTINUATION.

**Re-open condition:** a drawdown to the 200-day area or a documented multiple de-rating — a price event, not a new screen row — plus a buildable FCF-yield anchor.
